vat_outputs.note: Output VAT 13% from domestic goods sales (¥6,500,000 × 13%). Output VAT 6% from modern services incl. ¥2,100,000 cross-border IT/management services to UK sub + ¥150,000 local consulting. Input VAT from raw materials, equipment, office services.

cit_outputs.note: Standard 25% rate. Eligible for 15% high-tech enterprise reduction (assumed not yet certified in this period).

withholding_tax.dividend_note: Q1 2026: UK sub has not yet distributed dividends to HK holding (typical pattern: dividend declared at FY-end).
withholding_tax.royalty_note: Trademark licensing fee from UK sub to CN parent. 7% under 中港税收安排 (China-HK DTA, Article 11 Royalties).
withholding_tax.mgmt_fee_note: IT/management service fee from UK sub to CN parent. 5% under 中港税收安排 (Article 7 Business Profits, subject to beneficial owner test).

transfer_pricing.tp_method: Cost Plus 8-12% (CN parent provides services to UK sub at cost + markup)
transfer_pricing.tp_adjustment_note: Adjustment to bring intercompany pricing to arm's length range. +¥320,000 = additional taxable income in CN.
transfer_pricing.beps2_note: Group consolidated revenue < EUR 750M threshold, not subject to GloBE rules.

dac6_disclosures.hallmark_note: Cross-border arrangement between UK sub and CN parent (related party) where hallmark C1(b) applies: transfer pricing outcome not at arm's length.
dac6_disclosures.rod_note: Reportable OECD cross-border amount: ¥2,250,000 (sum of intra-group services + royalty)

cross_reference_to_uk_case.note: UK subsidiary's external sales (£282,750 Box 6) appear in CN parent's books only as 'import from related party' in intra-group cost side. The ¥2,100,000 service revenue on CN side is what UK sub pays as expense (purchase), so it is NOT in UK's Box 6 (Box 6 only counts external sales). This is the correct accounting treatment for group internal flows.
